searchText: Hey everyone! If you’re still planning to pitch a talk/presentation for the light client summit in Istanbul, please ensure you’ve signalled here with your pitch. Deadline for submission is Sunday Oct 22 For those who already have access to the co-working space at the Istanbul Congress Center, if you didn’t manage to get a ticket in time for the light client summit due to room capacity restrictions, you can show up on the day of to see if we can fit you in (basically a standby line). No guarantees for access, but that’s the best chance at this point.
